senses.gloss:
f. (-नी)
Ujjayanī or Oujein, a city so called in Mālava, formerly the capital of VIKRAMĀDITYA. It is one of the seven sacred cities of the Hindus, and the first meridian of their geographers: the modern Oujein is about a mile south of the ancient city.
E.
उत् much, जयनी victorious or place of victory; from the military character of its people; also अवन्ती and उज्जयिनी.

m. (-न्तः)
The name of a mountain, part of the chain in the west of India, part of the Vindhya range: see रैवत.
E.
उत् priv. and जयन्ति a banner, or जयन्त the son of INDRA.

f. (-नी)
The city Oujein.
E.
see उज्जयनी.

n. (-नं)
Killing, slaughter.
E.
उत्। जस to kill, and ल्युट् aff.
